posts.name: SRI KUMARAN C T
posts.cooked: Is it possible to do more than 2 repeat OPPEs?(Its not that i’ll fail everytime but, is it possible?)

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: If you are repeat OPPE student, then you will have to take up the whole course next time. If you have taken the whole course this time, then next time you can take only oppe (need to submit BPTs).

posts.name: SRI KUMARAN C T
posts.cooked: btw, does final score consider only one of the two OPPE marks or both of them?

posts.name: Gurkirat Singh
posts.cooked:
If you passed in first then you can’t give 2nd. So 1st will be considered.

If you failed so you will give 2nd and in that case 2nd will be considered.

Obv you have to pass in 2nd one as well in that case otherwise repeat oppe.

posts.name: SAVARIO SALET SUJITHRA
posts.cooked: Can you consider/ keep the previous theory marks if we fail in reoppe? Because of this We couldn’t move on to other courses . Please consider this request for oppe compulsory subjects.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
@SAVARIO_SALET_SUJITH

Yes, if you choose ‘Repeat oppe only’ rest of the marks such as quiz, ga, bpt & et are carried over. You have to re-do BPT for eligibility for OPPE and give OPPE only. However please refer to this table -
